name: Camping Wertacher Hof
beschreibung: Camping Wertacher Hof is located in Oy-Mittelberg in the Tyrolean Allgäu. The campsite is peacefully surrounded by forests and mountains. The complex offers spacious pitches and comfortable rental accommodations. An on-site restaurant serves delicious regional dishes. In the surrounding area, visitors will find scenic hiking trails and groomed cross-country ski trails. The campsite is ideally suited for nature lovers and families.
